description: Find auspicious dates for an event across a date range (the system ranks the dates by classical rules). Scores each day by vara, nakshatra, tithi, paksha and the native's Tara Bala / Chandra Bala / Sade Sati, per the event's rule table, returning candidates sorted by a deterministic score (with breakdown + weights), the Abhijit / clean best-window and the Rahu/Gulika/Yamaganda avoid-windows. A failed mandatory rule caps the score. event_type is one of: griha_pravesha_own, griha_pravesha_rented, travel_prayana, vehicle_purchase, business_shop_opening, property_purchase_registration. Data only — the caller writes the recommendation. (Use get_gochara_range instead to get raw per-day details and decide yourself.)

date.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 1985-06-15

event_place.description: Event place name (optional; defaults to birth place)

event_type.description: Event to find a date for

gender.description: Optional. A few classical yogas are defined by gender -- Mahabhagya's rule is gender x day/night x odd/even signs. Supply it when known; when omitted those yogas are left out of the result rather than computed against an assumed gender.

latitude.description: Birth-place latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 13.0827

longitude.description: Birth-place longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 80.2707

time.description: Birth time in 24h HH:MM:SS format, e.g. 10:30:00

timezone.description: Timezone offset from UTC in hours, e.g. 5.5 for IST

name: get_muhurta
title: Muhūrta (Auspicious Timing)
